thesis: PRE-MARKET (07:30 ET) read this Sunday 2026-08-16 with the completed Friday 2026-08-14 close (SPY 776.34) still the LAST COMPLETED daily bar and a full weekend gap between this read and the next session, planning Monday 2026-08-17. Markets are closed, so there is no fresh overnight/pre-market gap and no new session bar; the bars are unchanged from Friday. WHAT ACTUALLY CHANGED THIS RUN is the dealer map, not price: the positive-gamma cushion has thinned to razor-thin. options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (modelAsOf 2026-08-14T15:59:59Z, spot 776.34) still read SPY in POSITIVE dealer gamma, but signed net GEX has thinned to just +375M and the flip has RISEN to 775.35, now barely under the 776.34 spot, so the spot sits less than a point above the flip inside a tight 775-780 range (put wall 775, call wall 780); atmIV 5.45% is still below the calm headline VIX 14.25 but the front expected move has widened to plus-or-minus 3.13 (~plus-or-minus 0.40%). Flow stays call-heavy but now carries a near-the-money index-put tell: options-flow-feed-lab reads callFraction 0.6651 (call premium $1.34B against $674M of put premium across 12 tickers, 1459 contracts clearing the $250k bar), top prints led by NVDA 227.5 CALLS at $19.8M on 4.6x open interest (7DTE) and QQQ 730 CALLS at $18.1M (3DTE), but the third-largest is a SPY 776 PUT at $16.0M on 22.7x open interest (3DTE), a large hedge struck right at the flip/put-wall and absent from the prior window. The structural frame is otherwise intact: SPY 776.34 (pctFrom52wHigh -0.2), +3.71% over its 50-day (~748.6) and +10.47% over its 200-day (~702.8) on a deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, Double bottom pattern-qualified); the 8/14 session read a Mixed / developing auction under Algo-controlled control (intraday-tape-lab VWAP 776.63, 79 bars); completed-bar breadth is 51.05% of 134 (market-heatmap-lab, narrow, margin -8.95) so three-bar persistence is not re-established; the sizing model is NORMAL (volatility-sizing-lab conditional vol 12.859%, throttle x1.17). Leadership stays risk-on and clean: sector-research-lab reads Rotate toward XLK as XLE weakens, XLK is BOTH the highest relative-strength name AND Leading (rsMom 102.37, rsRatio 100.01, accel +2.55, quad L, +20.82% over its 200-day) funded from weakening energy/health/financials/industrials (XLE/XLV/XLF/XLI, all quad W) while XLY/XLP/XLRE lag (quad A) and XLU bases; etf-momentum-lab ranks VGT first (34.68%) with SPMO and QQQ behind; global-rotation-lab keeps EWS Singapore first (89 vs ACWI); real-assets-lab keeps copper CPER the outright lead (53.3) with GLD 38.2, BTC 32.3 and SLV 14.1 below (industrial-metals tilt, no dominant precious-metal haven; GLD 401.48 tangled, -2.64% under its 200-day). bond-regime-lab still cannot make the credit or duration call, an independent credit-spread reading is not available in this view yet, but its high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio reads strengthening through 8/14 on both aligned pairs, a mild risk-on tell with the curve positive. company-fundamentals-lab (MSFT) is partial with no direction available in this view yet (statement 2026-03-31, stale and pre-print); ai-capex-strategy-lab returns only a dated 2026-06-30 scenario-assumptions estimate, not measured returns; technical-analysis-decision-lab published only its data foundation and its owner five-gate model does not feed the brief yet; fx-regime-relative-value-lab withheld every currency family for lack of an approved source, so it is not applicable this window; and msft-july-print-model, smart-money-flow-lab, strategy-self-improvement-lab, strategy-validation-lab, trend-dynamics-cycle-lab, waterfront-polo-lab, palm-springs-rental-market-lab, ocean-shores-rental-market-lab, portfolio-survival-allocation-lab and research-agenda-lab made no call this cycle. PLAN, structure-first and a touch more defensive on the near-term tape than the after-hours read because the dealer cushion thinned to near-flat and a near-the-money SPY put appeared: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core, the 20>50>200 bull-stack is intact and SPMO holds above its 50-day (~150.5) with mom21 positive. HOLD the FIRST measured beta-add tranche but keep the remaining tranches gated and PAUSED, completed-bar breadth is still 51.05% (narrow) so do not add into a narrowing tape; release the rest only when a completed close re-reclaims and holds breadth above 60% while SPMO holds above ~150.5 and SPY holds above the 775.35 flip. ROTATE toward XLK (now both the highest-rsMom name and Leading, rotating in), funded from weakening energy/health/financials/industrials (XLE/XLV/XLF/XLI), keeping XLY/XLP/XLRE/XLU OUT. HOLD MSFT (495.40, maStack still tangled, mom252 -4.08 still negative) and do NOT chase the extended gap. On the hedge: the positive-gamma pin has thinned to +375M with the flip lifted to 775.35 right under the spot, a large SPY 776 put now sits among the top prints, and a weekend gap plus a still-unverified July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed path sit ahead, so carry a LIGHT-to-modest residual tail over the weekend while breadth stays below 60% and the cushion is thin, and retire it on a close that clears the 780 call wall with VIX under ~14.5. Open risk into 8/17: no scheduled high-importance release Monday, the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28, and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items.
